messages.subject: Hollis departure — agreed announcement and interim cover
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

We're close to a signed deal with Gareth. The agreed form of announcement (internal + external lines) is in the matter folder — please don't deviate from it; both sides have signed up to a non-derogatory clause. You'll cover the commercial function on an interim basis from February while we recruit the combined CCO role. Keep this confidential until the staff note goes out.

Sofia
